messages.subject: Project Cedar - report on title (draft 2)
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Isla,

Our report on title is attached. Headlines: title absolute, clean; searches passed (the site was a former railway goods yard, redeveloped in 2006 with a clean validation - we recommend relying on it); passing rent £1,062,500 (NIY ~7.0%); two units within rent-free periods to March 2026 (we've secured an apportionment in your favour); Unit 4 rent deposit transfers by deed; the Pennine charge is to be discharged from the proceeds under solicitors' undertaking. We've also flagged the tenant break options on Units 3 and 5 for your income modelling.

Subject to the open service-charge query on Unit 5 (now to be indemnified by the seller) we're comfortable for you to proceed.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
